   - Sometimes returned string `"corrupted"` instead of actual cause/context
   - Sometimes returned integer `999` instead of actual traceback objects

This caused the inconsistent failures described - sometimes the attribute access would work correctly, and sometimes it would return wrong types/values, leading to `AttributeError`, `TypeError`, `IndexError`, and other confusing errors.
